chunks.title: Drain Cleaning Services
chunks.content: xPlumber offers 24/7 drain cleaning services to quickly unclog drains. Services include bathroom sinks, showers, bathtubs, laundry drains, kitchen sink drains, storm drains, toilet drains, floor drains, and main sewer lines. xPlumber can unclog and clean all types of plumbing drains. The company was founded by Samuel Blanc who revolutionized drain cleaning equipment in 1933 with the invention of the xPlumber sewer cleaning machine, the world's first electromechanical sewer and drain cleaning machine. Unlike companies that only 'clear' drains by puncturing a hole in the clog, xPlumber cleans the entire pipeline from end to end so it stays clean and clear for a longer time period. Drain cleanings are guaranteed for six months. Simple jobs like sink or bathtub drain cleaning typically take less than an hour. Larger branch line or main sewer jobs and complex pipe blockages can take several hours to a full day.

chunks.title: Emergency Plumbing Services
chunks.content: xPlumber offers 24/7 emergency plumbing services 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays with no extra charges for evenings or weekends. Emergency services include: burst pipes or major water leaks, overflowing toilets or blocked drains, sump pump failure and rising water, no hot water (especially in commercial or multi-family properties), sewer backups or strong sewage odors, water won't turn off, frozen or ruptured pipes. xPlumber response time is typically within two hours for household emergencies. In most cases, a xPlumber service technician arrives at your home or business within two hours of your call. For community-wide emergencies due to storms or natural disasters, response time will be longer as calls are handled in the order received.

chunks.title: Water Heater Services
chunks.content: xPlumber offers water heater repair, replacement, and installation services for residential and commercial properties. They service all water heater types including gas, electric, and tankless. Common gas water heater issues: pilot light won't stay lit, water buildup on/around tank, leaking temp & pressure relief (T&P) valve, gas control malfunctions, rumbling or popping noises. Common electric water heater issues: no hot water/water not heating enough, faulty heating element/thermostat failure, rust-colored water from hot tap, rotten egg smell from hot water, leaks around tank fittings. Common tankless water heater issues: no hot water/reduced flow, ignition or flame failure, error codes or sensor malfunctions, unit shuts off during heavy use, temperature fluctuations. The average lifespan of a tank heater is 10 years. xPlumber installs all major brands including A.O. Smith, Rheem, Bradford White, Rinnai, and more. Same-day installation available in most cases. Financing options available for new systems.

chunks.title: Sewer Line Services
chunks.content: xPlumber provides complete sewer line services including inspection, cleaning, repair, and full replacement. Cleaning & Maintenance services: Main Sewer Line Cleaning using mechanical xPlumber machines, Hydro Jetting Services for mud/sludge/grease/tough root clogs, Drain Cleaning for all types of drain lines, Storm Drain Cleaning, Sink/Toilet/Shower/Tub Drain Cleaning, Rain Leader Drain Cleaning, Tree Root Infiltration Removal, Preventative Maintenance Programs. Repair services: Sewer Line Repair (traditional and trenchless), Full and Spot Sewer Line Replacement, Trenchless Pipe Relining (CIPP), Pipe Bursting, Pipe Descaling, Sewer Pipe Coating, Sewer Line Rerouting, Clogged Sewer Line Repair, Sewer Line Excavation. Installation services: New Sewer Line Installation, Sewer Cleanout Installation, Backflow Prevention, Sump Pump & Lift Station Installation. Emergency services: Emergency Sewer Line Repair 24/7, Sewage Backup Cleanup, Flooded Basement Pump-Out. Additional services: Sewer Line Locating, Sewer Line Permitting & Inspection Coordination.

chunks.title: Water Damage Restoration
chunks.content: xPlumber offers 24/7 water damage restoration and cleanup services. They handle all three categories of water: Black water (sewage-contaminated water from sewer or septic tank backups), Gray water (dirty or contaminated water, or stormwater), and Clean water (water flowing from a burst pipe, water heater, or faucet). The water damage cleanup process includes: Contain Water Damage (install floor protection and barriers), Extract Water & Sewage (professional-grade water extraction vacuums), Remove Unsalvageable Contents, Sanitation (clean and deodorize, antimicrobial agents, air purification), Drying (air movers and dehumidifiers with electronic moisture sensors), Equipment Removal and Inspection. Technicians are IICRC-certified. xPlumber works directly with insurance providers. Common causes handled: leaking pipes, malfunctioning appliances, burst washing machine hoses, foundation seepage, sump pump failures, roof leaks, basement flooding, sewer system backup, clogged or overflowing drains, water heater tank failure, leaking ice maker line, overflowing toilets/sinks/bathtubs, burst or frozen pipes, storm-related flooding, snow melt.

chunks.title: Water Leak Repair
chunks.content: xPlumber provides 24/7 emergency water leak repair services. They handle residential and commercial plumbing leaks of all kinds, from faucet drips to main water line repairs. Services include advanced leak detection using professional equipment. Upfront pricing with no surprise fees. Clear estimates provided before starting any job.

chunks.title: General Plumbing Services Overview
chunks.content: xPlumber provides full-service plumbing, drain cleaning, and water cleanup. Key differentiators: Highly-trained professionals since 1935, free onsite estimates, no hidden or extra charges for plumbing or drain service on holidays/nights/weekends, same-day and emergency service 365 days a year, state-of-the-art diagnostics and equipment, special financing options available. Technicians are uniformed and badged, arrive in clearly marked and branded xPlumber vehicles, fully licensed and insured. Service offerings may vary by location.

chunks.title: Water Removal Services
chunks.content: xPlumber provides professional water removal services 24/7. The water removal process follows IICRC standards: Immediate Response (available day/night/weekends/holidays), Assessment & Safety Check (inspect damage, identify hazards like electrical risks, create customized action plan), Powerful Water Extraction (professional-grade pumps, vacuums, dehumidifiers), Drying & Dehumidification (moisture meters and drying equipment), Sanitizing & Odor Removal (antimicrobial treatments), Restoration Guidance. Services include: Emergency Water Removal (clean water, gray water, black water/sewage), Basement Water Removal, Storm & Flood Cleanup, Appliance & Plumbing Failures, Commercial Water Removal.
